name: comp-25

frames.best_why: A query fills the field while the shortcut badge stays visible, with no cursor over the box.

tagline: A search box with a tiny command-key badge tucked inside its right edge.
summary: A labelled search field with a small bordered shortcut badge fixed inside the right edge. Typing shows a native clear cross beside the badge; the shortcut itself is only a visual hint.
appearance: A label sits above a rounded dark search field on a black stage. A grey Search... placeholder starts at the left, a tiny outlined ⌘K key badge hugs the right edge, and typing a query brings a small x cross before the badge.
behaviour: Clicking the field draws a pale ring and typing replaces the placeholder with the query, which also produces a small clear cross next to the shortcut badge. The clip enters pricing table and the badge holds its place throughout.
demo_content: Label Search input with <kbd>, Search... placeholder, typed query pricing table.
search_phrases: box with a command k hint
quick find field with a shortcut
type to find with cmd k
filter field with a key badge
look up products with a hotkey
keyboard hint inside a search box
use_when: A page search that also advertises a command menu opening on the same shortcut.
avoid_when: The badge is decorative only; nothing listens for the shortcut, so it can mislead users.
customise: The label, placeholder and shortcut badge text are written in the file; field and badge styling are classes there as well.
weight_why: One field plus a static badge; nothing animates or listens in the background.

a11y.note: The label is bound to the field, but the shortcut badge is decorative and never fires the key it shows.

issues: The badge promises a ⌘K shortcut that the code never binds to any action.
polish_why: Crisp field and a neat key badge, but the shortcut hint is only decoration.
title: Search Keyboard Shortcut Input
